# Task #66 deterministic Human Wizard level 20 Abjuration-school fixture.
# Widens the task-66 Abjuration fixtures to level 20, the character-level
# cap and the level at which Resistance's DESC text (not a BONUS:VAR
# formula) replaces "resistance" with "immunity" to an energy type
# (PREVARGTEQ:AbjurationProgressionSchoolLVL,20 on the second DESC line of
# the Abjuration School ~ Resistance record in cr_abilities_class.lst).
# Since Immunity is a tokenless, non-numeric capstone (the commented-out
# `#Immunity` KEY record in the corpus is not an active ability record), it
# stays deferred/named-only per this task's scope: at level 20 the
# Resistance flat-magnitude explanation must NOT fire (there is no longer a
# numeric "resistance" value to ground -- the DESC itself says the
# character gains immunity instead), while Protective Ward and Energy
# Absorption, which have no such level-20 discontinuity, keep grounding
# their level-scaled magnitudes.
